<thought>We have a single measurement: resistance between A and X1 is 6.667 Ω. The notes say there are two resistors, one twice the other. The simplest topology that fits is two resistors in series: R and 2R, giving total 3R = 6.667 Ω → R ≈ 2.222 Ω and 2R ≈ 4.445 Ω. This matches the “left‑to‑right” labeling (R1 then R2). I will present the series topology with these values.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors":{"R1":2.222,"R2":4.445},"connections":[["A","B","R1"],["B","X1","R2"]]}</final_answer>
